page.overview:
What is Dizzy Miss Lizzy?

Dizzy Miss Lizzy is a cover song by The Beatles that appeared on the album Help!.

This song was first released in the U.S. on Beatles VI, on Side 2. It was recorded at Abbey Road Studios in England on May 10, 1965, which was also Larry Williams' 30th birthday. Along with Bad Boy, it was recorded because Capitol needed more songs to fill out Beatles VI. While Bad Boy would remain unreleased in the U.K. until December 1966, Dizzy Miss Lizzy ended up becoming the ending track for the Help! LP. In several countries, it also appeared as the B-side of the "Yesterday" single.
